name: Grok 3 mini

lifecycle.note: grok-3-mini is not named in the May 15, 2026 retirement guide and the current xAI models overview no longer lists it; no primary source available for this review states whether or when it was retired.

sources.locator: Our path of progress, 2025: Grok 3 API

released.note: The release note says the Grok 3 models became generally available on the API without naming Grok 3 mini separately; the announcement had said Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini would come to the API.

relations.note: Editorial link along the mini tier: the announcement introduces Grok 3 mini next to Grok 3 without naming a predecessor; Grok-2 mini was the previous small model.

summary.text: Grok 3 mini is a smaller xAI language model, unveiled alongside Grok 3 on 19 February 2025 with a beta reasoning model, Grok 3 mini (Think). xAI presented it as cost-efficient reasoning for STEM tasks that need less world knowledge; the Grok 3 models became generally available on the xAI API on 3 April 2025.

changes.text: Announced with a beta reasoning model, Grok 3 mini (Think), trained with large-scale reinforcement learning.

sources.locator: Thinking Harder: Test-time Compute and Reasoning

changes.text: xAI positions it as cost-efficient reasoning for STEM tasks that do not need as much world knowledge.

sources.locator: Thinking Harder: Test-time Compute and Reasoning

features.note: Announced as the beta reasoning model Grok 3 mini (Think).

notes: Official spelling at release is Grok 3 mini (the API docs later wrote Grok 3 Mini). Consumer-app availability is not stated in a primary source, so access lists only the API. Modalities and context window were documented on the archived xAI API model page (https://docs.x.ai/docs/models/grok-3-mini), which could not be opened for this review, so they are left out. Lifecycle: an archived June 2026 docs capture reportedly lists grok-3-mini as an alias of grok-4.3; it could not be opened for this review, so lifecycle stays unknown.
